en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two main images and floral ornaments. On the left is a narrow old European street scene labelled "HOFGASSE MIT STIEGENKÄCHE" showing tall town houses, shop signs and a small church tower in the background. At the top left a banner reads "Gruss aus Graz." On the right is the storefront of a shop with the sign "ANTON A. SCHWARZ" above arched windows and a central door. Below this image a ribbon‑style caption mentions the types of goods sold. There is faint handwritten correspondence in pencil covering the lower right area of the card.
